products: About five years ago, I started to learn about a more self-sufficient lifestyle. I started small with a few veggie plants on the back porch, and it's now grown to a 60'x30' garden, chickens, ducks, turkeys, and a pet pig! We call it our "farmlet" and hope to watch it continue to grow! As I was learning, I found canning to be a great way to preserve, and it also made a little money on the side. I just LOVE making jellies and jams and hearing how they remind people of their grandmother's or their favorite restaurants'. I hope to add to more listings as I learn and grow. I create homemade Jams, Jellies, Fruit butters and honeys.
